:::{#thm-deriv-lincom}

#### Derivative of a dot product

If $\vx$ is constant with respect to $\vcoef$, then:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef} (\vx \cdot \vcoef)}_{p \times 1}
&=
\underbrace{\deriv{\vcoef} (\vcoef \cdot \vx)}_{p \times 1} \\
&=
\underbrace{\vx}_{p \times 1}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
